title: Serving sovereignty: How local food is taking center stage in Bulacan

blocks.text: As climate change, global market disruptions, food import dependence and the homogenization of diets increasingly threaten Philippine food security, a growing number of Filipinos are rediscovering the strategic importance of local food systems. The Food and Agriculture Organization, in its 2024 report on the state of food security and nutrition, has underscored the continuing importance of resilient food systems in addressing food insecurity and malnutrition. Food nationalism, understood as the conscious preference for locally produced food and support for indigenous agriculture, has emerged as an important pathway toward food sovereignty, dietary resilience, environmental stewardship and cultural preservation.
